dataset_metadata.description: Ground truth annotations for the mock documents. Used to evaluate AI precision and recall.

expected_outcomes.requirement: The manufacturer shall establish, document and maintain throughout the lifecycle an ongoing process for identifying hazards associated with a medical device.
expected_outcomes.ground_truth_reasoning: Section 3.1 and 3.2 explicitly document the comprehensive hazard analysis process and list identified hazards.

expected_outcomes.requirement: For each identified hazard, the manufacturer shall estimate the probability of occurrence of harm and the severity of that harm.
expected_outcomes.ground_truth_reasoning: Section 4 explicitly states they have 'temporarily suspended the creation of the Risk Evaluation Matrix (Probability vs. Severity)'.

expected_outcomes.requirement: The manufacturer shall document a policy for determining acceptable risk.
expected_outcomes.ground_truth_reasoning: Section 4 explicitly notes the team is 'still debating the threshold for ALARP', indicating no formal policy is documented.

expected_outcomes.requirement: The manufacturer shall implement encryption for data in transit to ensure the confidentiality of sensitive device control commands.
expected_outcomes.ground_truth_reasoning: Section 3.2 explicitly states 'we have opted not to implement application-layer AES encryption for the insulin dosage commands or historical logs during transit.'

expected_outcomes.requirement: The system architecture shall document all communication interfaces, including wireless connections.
expected_outcomes.ground_truth_reasoning: Section 2.3 explicitly lists the Communication & Interface Subsystem (CIS) handling BLE connections.

expected_outcomes.requirement: Protected Health Information (PHI) stored on the device must be protected using encryption at rest.
expected_outcomes.ground_truth_reasoning: Section 3.3 explicitly states that the last 90 days of insulin delivery history is 'stored in plain text'.
